-- 查询 jiang 接收到的共享连接
SELECT 
  csc.sharerId,
  u.username as sharerUsername,
  COUNT(c.id) as contactCount
FROM contact_sharing_connections csc
LEFT JOIN users u ON csc.sharerId = u.id
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.parentUserId = csc.sharerId
WHERE csc.receiverId = 29 
  AND csc.status = 'active'
GROUP BY csc.sharerId, u.username;

-- 查询分享者（用户30）的联系人总数
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM contacts WHERE parentUserId = 30;
